opennyai_summary.15_July_2024__PREAMBLE:
Ajit Biswas vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024
 12
15-07-2024
(ct. no.28) Kole Crm (Db) 1905 of 2024 In re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the
Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Gazole Police Station Case No. 456 of 2023 dated
09.06.2023 under Sections 363/365/342/376(2)(n)/506 of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the
Pocso Act.
-And- 
In the matter of : Ajit Biswas .... Petitioner.
Mr. Wasim Akram, ... For the Petitioner.
Mr. Ranadeb Sengupta, Mr. Ivan Roy, ... For the State.
The petitioner says that he has been falsely implicated.
There was a love affair between him and the victim girl.
They eloped together.
He is in custody for one year and twenty two days.
Witness action has not yet begun.
opennyai_summary.15_July_2024__facts:
This case has been falsely lodged by the victim girl's father when he came to know about the affair.
He should be enlarged on bail.
Allegedly she was made to drink some water, which had something in it, as a result whereof, the victim girl became dizzy.
Thereafter, she was raped many times.
opennyai_summary.15_July_2024__ANALYSIS:
Learned Advocate for the State while opposing the prayer for bail, draws to our attention the statement of the victim girl who clearly narrates the alleged incident.
In view of the prima facie incriminating evidence against the petitioner, we are not inclined to entertain his prayer for bail, at this stage.
opennyai_summary.15_July_2024__decision:
CRM (DB) 1905 of 2024 is, thus, dismissed.
However, considering the lengthy period of detention of the petitioner, we direct the learned Trial Court to expedite the trial to the fullest extent and conclude the same at an early date and positively within one year from the next date fixed for recording of evidence, without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties and if necessary by fixing frequent schedules for examination.
In the event, the learned Trial Court does not conclude the trial within the time period indicated herein, the petitioner will be at liberty to renew his prayer for bail.
Parties are directed to communicate this order to the learned Trial Court.
All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.

-And-

... for the petitioner Ms. Shaila Afrin, Mr. Arup Sarkar ... ...For the State
opennyai_summary.final__facts: Out of 14 witnesses, only one witness has been examined partly.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
The victim was made to drink some water and when she became dizzy, she was raped.
The statement of the victim discloses of such sexual assault which has also been stated by the her in Court during her examination.
She seeks for dismissal of the application.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Perused the Case Diary and the materials placed.
It is found that the victim has stated of such sexual assault by the petitioner in her statement as well as in her deposition in Court.
It is found that such period of one year has not yet elapsed.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
By order dated 15th July, 2024 passed in CRM(DB) 1905 of 2024, the bail prayer was dismissed with a direction upon the Trial Court to expedite the trial to the fullest extent and conclude the same at an early date and positively within one year from the next date fixed for recording of evidence,
without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties and if necessary by fixing frequent schedules for examination.
Considering the above and bearing in mind the gravity of the offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.
The application for bail being CRM(DB)
620 of 2025 stands dismissed.
